find_cards_by_name.description: Find every card whose name contains the text given: "agumon" brings back Agumon and every one of its dozens of printings and forms. The way to turn a name a person typed into card numbers. No API key required.

cards.main_effect:
<Security Attack +1> (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card).
